name: What is the process for requesting hardware and functional adjustments after a project is completed?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for requesting hardware and functional adjustments after a project is completed?

acceptedAnswer.text: If adjustments are needed after your project is completed, simply contact Frasheski Construction. We will discuss the specific issues you're experiencing and schedule a visit to assess the situation. During our visit, our team will identify the necessary adjustments and carry them out efficiently. We recommend noting all observations for a comprehensive review. This structured process helps us address concerns promptly and effectively, ensuring your continued satisfaction. This outlines our process clearly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Contact Frasheski Construction with the specific issues, and we will schedule a visit to assess and perform the necessary adjustments.
